findings.F1: In the falling agitated profile, the 30-day return runs against the next 7 days: Spearman rho is -0.30 (p 0.0005, 134 grid cases on 37 days). The deepest fifth of months (mean 30-day return -51 %) is followed by an unusual move of +9.0 % over 7 days, and the fifth near -14 % by -7.3 %. The rho is negative in each of the four years (-0.19 to -0.34) and at 3 days (-0.13, p 0.015, 348 cases) and 14 days (-0.41, p 0.006, 44 cases). This is the long rebound that the map's falling agitated cell already holds (16 strategies, including 066-01 "sixty day scaled fall rebound"), so it is not a discovery. The short half is weak: rising months in falling agitated markets give -3.4 % (t -0.89, 21 cases).
findings.F2: In choppy markets the month's move continues, as the brief claims. Rho is +0.33 in choppy calm (p 0.004, 76 cases on 33 days) and +0.24 in choppy agitated (p 0.07, 59 cases on 35 days). The continuation return, signed by the month's direction, is +3.8 % (clustered t 1.49) in choppy calm and +5.5 % (t 1.91) in choppy agitated. Neither t reaches 2 once the cases of one day are taken together.
findings.F3: The falls that continue sit mostly in choppy agitated markets, not choppy calm ones. The lowest third of 30-day returns is followed by -11.2 % unusual over 7 days in choppy agitated (clustered t -1.74, about 20 cases) against -3.5 % in choppy calm (t -0.93). The round-1 split, with agitation read as 30-day against 120-day volatility, agrees: the lowest fifth gives -11.8 % in agitated chop (t -3.5, 18 cases, not clustered) and -8.5 % in calm chop (9 cases). The map's choppy agitated short cell is empty (0 strategies).
findings.F4: The book earns nothing from the confirmed effect. Its daily mean is positive in only 6 of the 12 explored windows, between -0.076 % and +0.124 %. Its 458 short trades lose after fees in every forecast tercile: mean net -4.46 %, -0.83 % and -1.63 %, medians -2.25 %, -1.56 % and -1.90 %. The coins drift up 1.15 % per 7 days against the short.
findings.F5: The other angles show nothing that stands out once same-day cases are counted together:

ideas.idea: In a choppy, agitated market, the further a coin's close sits below its close of 30 days earlier, as a plain percent of that earlier close, the more it falls over the next 7 days, with the deepest falls carrying most of the decline.
ideas.consequence: A trader shorts a coin's month-long fall in a trendless but agitated market, in proportion to the fall's depth, and leaves the same fall alone when the market is calm.
ideas.name: choppy agitated month falls continue
